== Notes ==
*There are no traps, nor any ranger skills, that apply cracked armor.
**Therefore, consider selectively laying Piercing Trap next to a foe that has just received cracked armor, either from a secondary profession skill or a fellow party member.
*Damage is dealt in two [[packet]]s. First the trap is triggered and deals unconditional damage, then the second packet is dealt only to enemies who have cracked armor. If an enemy is in a [[Well of Ruin]] when the trap is triggered, the initial damage will inflict cracked armor, causing the bonus damage to trigger as well.

== Trivia ==
*The figure in the [[skill icon]] appears to be a male necromancer wearing [[Necromancer Cabal armor|Cabal armor]].
